notes: Full text read at https://arxiv.org/html/2504.01195 . The diffusion model performs inverse unit-cell design and some returned designs are checked in Abaqus (Section 2.3). Topology optimization is discussed only as motivation (Introduction and Conclusion). Supplement S5 Table S7 compares FE forward-simulation time with neural inference and gives inverse-design inference time, but does not run, time or cite the result/cost of a classical optimizer. Therefore the numerical FE timing is not an optimization-level baseline.
